name: James Blunt
notes: UK acoustic confessional pop: 78–97 straight with the backbeat on 2&4 and the signature single at 82, which is where `bpm.mode` sits — the one published figure in the entry. The drum block is defined by what is missing: "minimal live kit with brushes or a soft loop", "kick 1 and 3, snare/rim on 2&4, 8th shaker", "whole sections with no drums at all", and "a single tambourine layer arriving at the final chorus". Those are the three deltas — the softest velocity tier in this section, an 8th hat at a 0.18 fill density, and a shaker/rim/tambourine perc block — plus a `dropOutBeats` of 0.95 for the sections with no kit. Harmony is I–V–vi–IV with a suspended-IV pre-chorus and the same loop in all sections, so the sus substitution is authored and one family dominates. The melody rule is the entry's most useful: the vocal is "delivered in a strained high tenor with the apex note in the first bar of the chorus; note density low and the phrasing very even" — a high register, a 2–5 density and a `straightEighthsProb` of 0.6 for the evenness. ⚠ `confidence` is medium because the research says so, and the entry marks the harmonic claims **[LOW-CONF]**: the key claims are convention-based, not sourced per song, so `keys` is left inherited. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are all drum probabilities and the counter block. ⛔ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than `reese_sustain`, and that is an engine limit rather than a reading of the record.** `reese_sustain` is the only rhythm `bass.rs` reads that holds a note, and it emits one note per chord — TASK-162, still open — so this model measured **365 distinct basslines in 1,000 seeds** on it against `bass.rs`'s floor of 500. `mirror_kick` with a high root lock is the roster-wide substitution for a sustained sub (`dmx`, `coolio`, `krs-one`, `mobb-deep` all record the same one), and over a kick that plays 1 and 3 with a `3&` it reads as held at this tempo. The research is *"played bass on roots, long notes, mixed low; often absent from verse 1"*, and `M2` joins `P5` on the *"suspended-IV pre-chorus"* line. ⚠ **INFERRED:** `followRootsProb` 0.92 and `anticipationProb` 0.16 are lane-conventional for a played ballad bass; the entry marks its harmony and drum detail convention-derived already.
